events.label: first mention
events.text: Castle first mentioned in surviving records.

evidence.quote: Gleaston Castle is first mentioned in 1389

events.label: papal indult
events.text: John Harington granted papal indult for a private chapel.

evidence.quote: In 1415 John Harington was granted a papal indult for a private chapel

events.text: Harington family ownership ends; castle passes to William Bonville by marriage.

evidence.quote: until 1458 when it passed to William Bonville through marriage
The Harington family owned Gleaston Castle until William Harington , 5th Baron Harington died in 1458

events.label: abandonment
events.text: Castle subsequently abandoned after transfer to Bonville.

evidence.quote: until 1458 when it passed to William Bonville through marriage and was subsequently abandoned
It is likely that around this time Gleaston Castle was abandoned

events.text: Bonville dies; castle passes to Thomas Grey, 1st Marquess of Dorset, by marriage.

evidence.quote: He died in 1460 and the castle passed to Thomas Grey

events.label: antiquarian survey
events.text: John Leland records the castle ruins in his antiquarian notes.

evidence.quote: In 1540 , the antiquarian John Leland noted there is a ruine

events.text: Henry Grey executed for treason; castle property taken over by the monarch.

evidence.quote: 1st Duke of Suffolk was executed for treason in 1554
executed for treason in 1554 his property was taken over by the monarch

events.text: Thomas Preston, 3rd Baronet, buys Aldingham manor including the castle.

evidence.quote: In 1671 Thomas Preston , 3rd Baronet Preston bought Aldingham manor

events.text: Prestons sell the castle to the current family of owners.

evidence.quote: The Prestons owned the castle until 1922 when it was sold to the current family of owners

events.label: assessment
events.text: Lancaster University Archaeological Unit assesses the standing building.

evidence.quote: in 1998 the Lancaster University Archaeological Unit conducted an assessment of the standing building

events.label: survey
events.text: Morecambe Bay Partnership commissions Greenlane Archaeology aerial survey of castle.

evidence.quote: was not fully recorded until 2015 , when the Morecambe Bay Partnership

events.label: survey
events.text: University of Central Lancashire undertakes geophysical survey of the castle.

evidence.quote: In 2016 the University of Central Lancashire undertook a geophysical survey
